title: My first game: Frontline Zero, a multiplayer RTS
author: Savings-Theme4022
selftext:
**BLUF Free to play right on your browser:** [**www.frontlinezero.com**](http://www.frontlinezero.com/)

Hey all. I made a game called Frontline Zero. It's a multiplayer RTS where you can play as either Ukraine or Russia in the ongoing war.

I wanted to bring back the nostalgia of late '90s RTS games while mixing in modern RTS mechanics and elements of today's warfare. The gameplay is inspired by Red Alert 2, with a zone-based economy similar to Company of Heroes and a UI that takes inspiration from C&C and StarCraft.

At the same time, I wanted the game to reflect how warfare has evolved, with traditional air support being easily denied, drones dominating the skies, and electronic warfare playing a major role. The goal was to bring all of this together while keeping that classic RTS feel.

I'd love for you all to give it a try.

The game is completely free to play. I only added a paid version in case it takes off and some of you want to help cover the costs of running the online infrastructure.

Thanks and have fun!

\---

Frontline Zero runs on webrts, my own TypeScript RTS engine. The simulation is fully deterministic: integer math, one seeded RNG, 25 ticks a second, and every action is an “order”. Same orders in, same battle out, on every machine.

Netcode is lockstep: players send only their orders, a Cloudflare Durable Object groups them into turns and compares state hashes to catch desyncs. A replay is just the order log. Graphics: 3D models voxelized into 32-angle isometric sprites, drawn with Canvas 2D or WebGL 2.

Opus 5.5 was used for most of the code + artwork. Fable 5.1 was used briefly for network code.

Please let me know if you have any questions on the dev process, I'd love to answer them. I'm having a ton of fun making this.
